claims.claim: SpaceX has informed NASA it will end Crew Dragon and Falcon 9 crewed missions after 2030.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX has informed NASA that it will end Crew Dragon and Falcon 9 crewed missions to low Earth orbit after 2030.
claims.source_title: SpaceX moves to withdraw Dragon, Falcon 9 crewed missions after 2030, widening NASA low Earth orbit gap
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX has told the U.S. space agency NASA that it intends to stop low Earth orbit crewed missions using Crew Dragon and Falcon 9 after 2030.

claims.claim: Hanwha Aerospace has begun final assembly of a 12.2 meter reusable technology demonstrator.
claims.episode_span: Hanwha Aerospace has begun final assembly of a reusable technology demonstrator under a Korea Aerospace Research Institute project.
claims.source_title: Hanwha's 'Korean SpaceX' ambitions grow as work begins on reusable rocket test vehicle
claims.supporting_quote: Hanwha Aerospace has started building a test vehicle designed to take off, climb and land back on its feet, an early step toward Korean-made reusable rockets.

claims.claim: Anthropic agreements with SpaceX total up to $84.5 billion through May 2029.
claims.episode_span: Anthropic has entered agreements worth up to $84.5 billion with SpaceX for data center capacity.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Set To Receive $84.5 Billion From Anthropic In AI Capacity Payments, Says Report
claims.supporting_quote: Anthropic's IPO filings outline that the firm has entered into agreements to pay SpaceX as much as $84.5 billion for the firm's NVIDIA GPU chips in its data centers.
